packages.usage: Development lint/config/cache/glob chain. Repository-controlled file patterns; no production HTTP input path found. Maintainer describes minimatch 10.2.6 preprocessing with optimizationLevel>=2. Root v3.1.5 has no optimizationLevel implementation, and locked TypeScript-ESLint calls nested v10.2.6 with {dot:true}, leaving default level 1. npm flags all <11.0.1; retain that audit finding rather than asserting it absent.
packages.plan: Record explicit development-only residual for GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249. Do not install npm suggested ESLint 4.0.0/eslint-config-next 0.2.4 downgrades. Do not globally override minimatch 11: minimatch 3 exports a callable CommonJS function while 11 exports an object, breaking legacy consumers; TypeScript-ESLint nested ^10.2.2 also does not admit 11. Follow up with a compatible ESLint/TypeScript-ESLint/plugin/glob family migration or maintainer backport; rerun the full lint/typecheck/test/build envelope and audit.
